name: @openlight/programs
description: First-party webview programs the host ships. Each entry bundles to a JS file the program chunk's body.executable names.

scripts.build: bun run build:read-tile && bun run build:sidebar
scripts.build:read-tile: bun build src/read-tile/index.tsx --outfile read-tile.js --target browser --format iife --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"'
scripts.build:sidebar: bun build src/sidebar/index.tsx --outfile sidebar.js --target browser --format iife --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"'
